name: Sap Hana Cli
description: 150+ SAP HANA database tools for AI assistants. Query tables, import/export data, profile data quality, compare schemas, manage backups, monitor performance, and more. Connects to SAP HANA Cloud and on-premise databases.
longDescription:
Ships **1 MCP server**, `hana-cli`.

Installs with `claude plugin install sap-hana-cli@claude-plugins-official` from `SAP-samples/hana-cli-claude-plugin`.

150+ SAP HANA database tools as AI-powered MCP tools for Claude Code.

150+ SAP HANA database tools for AI assistants. Query tables, import/export data, profile data quality, compare schemas, manage backups, monitor performance, and more. Connects to SAP HANA Cloud and on-premise databases.
